title: Customer export attached to the wrong vendor ticket

events.summary: Monthly customer export (CSV, 41,200 rows) attached to vendor ticket VT-5521 instead of internal ticket IT-5521.
Vendor agent reports an unexpected attachment on VT-5521 and asks what to do with it.
Vendor agent reports an unexpected attachment on VT-5521 and asks what to do with it.
Privacy office confirms the attachment contains personal data of customers; incident opened.
Escalated to the incident lead Priya Oduya and legal.
Vendor confirms attachment deleted from VT-5521 and from their mail archive; two agents had opened it.
Export job log retrieved: 41,200 rows, columns email, name, last invoice amount, loyalty tier.
Vendor attestation of deletion requested from Tomas Ferreira at Deskwright; awaiting signed copy.

circumstances.dpcJustification: Invoice amount alone gives limited insight into financial status (ENISA financial-data decreasing factor).

containment.title: Confirm deletion of the attachment at the recipient
Obtain signed deletion attestation from the vendor
Disable the export job until the ticket-routing fix ships
Review vendor mail-archive retention for residual copies

facts.nature: A customer export file was attached to a vendor support ticket by mistake and opened by two vendor agents before deletion.
facts.categoriesOfSubjects: Retail customers with at least one purchase in the last 24 months.
facts.categoriesOfRecords: Email address, full name, last invoice amount, loyalty tier.
facts.measuresTaken: Attachment deleted at the recipient; export job disabled.
